title: DFS (Depth First Search)
intuition: Explore paths completely to leaf/dead-end nodes using recursive stack backtracking before tracing back.
step_by_step_strategy: Define helper function taking current node.
For each unvisited neighbor, call helper recursively.
common_mistakes: Missing base/visited state conditions causing infinite loops
complexity: Time: O(V + E), Space: O(V) due to call stack
content: Explore paths completely to leaf/dead-end nodes using recursive stack backtracking before tracing back.
